content_policy.description: The app is fully offline and ships only content that may be redistributed inside it: Tanzil text and metadata, the Tanzil English transliteration (written permission), and cpfair/quran-align CC BY 4.0 word timings. There is no Quran Foundation content, no runtime Content API access, no OAuth2/token-broker path and no English translation in this bundle. Recitation audio stays disabled until Quran Foundation confirms sources in writing.
